tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation and includes both positive and negative outcomes. A stationary forecast at H = 1.1 is not supported, so abstain without further measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Finer sampling could characterize the oscillations, but the paid pilot already establishes the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature that triggers abstention.

The supplied Vogel–Fulcher and stretched-exponential laws have fixed-sign outputs on these inputs. The supplied Andrade law can change sign at most once as H increases, whereas the paid outcomes change sign three times.
